meta.name: Small Prophets
meta.description: The magical and mundane unfold in a suburban shed as a lonely man stumbles on the supernatural.

videos.title: Down at the Cul-de-Sac
videos.overview: Since his partner Clea went missing seven years ago, Michael Sleep's life has been on hold. But a mystical recipe in an old journal promises answers he’s been longing for.

videos.title: Is This Legal?
videos.overview: Michael converts his shed into an alchemist's laboratory, but Clive is getting suspicious. Kacey invites Michael to the pub, where he says too much about his mysterious experiment.

videos.title: Should I Be Scared?
videos.overview: Michael witnesses a crime and is questioned by the police. Meanwhile, Clive obsesses about a black rabbit, and Kacey visits Marvin Gardens and is shocked by what she sees.

videos.title: The Birds of America
videos.overview: Clive is seething when a truckload of steaming horse manure is dumped in front of Michael's house. Kacey comes round to help bury the jars and asks Michael about the hoarded boxes.

videos.title: Who's Gonna Make Me Laugh?
videos.overview: Strange things are happening in Marvin Gardens, and they're starting to attract unwanted attention. It's time for Kacey and Michael to exhume the prophets from their pile of manure.

videos.title: The Wise Man's Song
videos.overview: The prophets are looking sick, Michael hasn't asked his questions, and all hell has broken loose in Marvin Gardens. It seems like the end of the line — or the start of a new adventure.

meta.slogan: A magical recipe unlocks new hope years after a mysterious disappearance.
